\title{PipedPeer: Figure Preview}
\author{\IEEEauthorblockN{Draft for the authors}
\IEEEauthorblockA{Evaluation figures from the container sample are stamped

\begin{abstract}
Every design diagram and evaluation figure planned for the paper, placed at the
exact size it will have in the IEEE two-column layout (252\,pt single column,
516\,pt double column: IEEEtran's own column and text widths), so labels, line weights and spacing can be judged as
printed. Captions are drafts. Regenerate with
\texttt{docs/paper/build-preview.sh}; \texttt{docs/paper/FIGURES.md} lists each
figure's file, width and paper section.
\end{abstract}
